title: Commentary on John, Book 13
blurb: Origen’s Commentary on John, Book 13 (later tomoi). Complete on this page: §§1–64.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Commentary on John Book 13 — no previous English translation of these later tomoi (ANF covers only earlier books). This page is Book 13 §§1–64 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Preuschen, Origenes Werke IV (GCS 10, 1903). Heine FOTC was not used as wording. This page is Book 13 §§1–64 of the later books (13, 19, 20, 28, 32).
